change.title: pr-36882-flat
change.description: Add rolling-updates feature flag and compatibility framework
change.author: Cristian Sotomayor

findings.title: The claim that the Operator "will fail" without `rolling-updates` doesn't match the code
findings.body: The new CAUTION block says the Operator will fail unless `rolling-updates` is enabled. Nothing in `operator/src/main` mentions `rolling-updates` or `ROLLING_UPDATES`. The update logic is chosen by `UpgradeLogicFactory` (`operator/src/main/java/org/keycloak/operator/upgrade/UpgradeLogicFactory.java:38-41`), and neither it nor `BaseUpgradeLogic`/`RecreateOnImageChangeUpgradeLogic` checks the feature or runs `update-compatibility`. A CR with `update.strategy` set and the feature off reconciles exactly as before. Either say what the feature will gate later (for example: "will be required by future versions"), or add the check so the doc becomes true.

findings.title: Adding `--features=rolling-updates` to the documented command replaces the user's own feature list
findings.body: The macro now renders `bin/kc.sh update-compatibility <params> --features=rolling-updates`. A CLI option takes priority over `KC_FEATURES` or `features=` in `keycloak.conf`. So a user who copies this command while other features are configured runs `metadata`/`check` with only `rolling-updates` (plus defaults) enabled. That contradicts the guide's own warning that every configuration option must be included (`docs/guides/server/update-compatibility.adoc:72-74`, `:87-91`). Today the result only compares versions, so the outcome doesn't change yet. It will once features feed into the metadata. Consider telling users to add `rolling-updates` to their existing `features` value instead of hard-coding a separate option.

contracts.action: `update-compatibility check|metadata` exit with code 4 and an error message when the ROLLING_UPDATES feature is disabled
contracts.equivalent_path: The existing result path in the same `run()` calls `picocli.exit(result.exitCode())` after printing messages (UpdateCompatibilityCheck.java:54-57).
contracts.before_after: Before: the commands always ran. After: the feature check runs first and exits through `Picocli.exit`, which calls `System.exit` for any non-zero code outside test launch mode. `return` stops the rest of `run()` in test mode. The Profile is initialised before execute() because `PropertyMappers.sanitizeDisabledMappers()` calls `Environment.getCurrentOrCreateFeatureProfile()`, so `Profile.isFeatureEnabled` cannot NPE here.
contracts.visible_effect: stderr shows "Unable to use this command. The preview feature 'rolling-updates' is not enabled." and the process exits with 4. The guide documents 4, and the recreate code moves from 4 to 3 to match the guide's existing table.
contracts.failure_mode: Scripts that relied on the old exit code 4 for 'recreate' will now get 4 for 'feature disabled'. A script that treats any non-zero code as recreate still falls back to a recreate, which is safe.

contracts.action: UpgradeTest enables the rolling-updates feature on the CR when an update strategy is set
contracts.before_after: The feature is only set when the strategy is non-null. The operator never reads the feature, so the test's behaviour is unchanged.
contracts.visible_effect: none for the operator; the custom test image is built with `--features=rolling-updates`.

summary: This change adds a preview feature, `ROLLING_UPDATES`, and the `update-compatibility` commands now refuse to run without it, exiting with code 4. The recreate exit code changes from 4 to 3, so the code now matches the exit-code table the guide already had. The code path is correct: the feature profile is set up before the command runs, and the early exit goes through `Picocli.exit`. I have two documentation suggestions, both at "consider": (1) the operator guide says the Operator will fail without the feature, but no operator code checks it; (2) the command template adds `--features=rolling-updates`, which overrides any features the user has already configured. That contradicts the guide's instruction to pass the full configuration.
